behavior.confirmation: Creator tool invokes a real LangGraph human-input interrupt; no model-facing approval or planHash parameter. Decline/unanswered never invokes apply. The question step binds the exact plan hash.
behavior.installedVersion: Node createRequire resolves catalog from target project; catalog/package identity, snapshot hashes, runtime hashes and source manifest ID/version are verified.
behavior.planInvalidation: Project source, metadata, model, package manifest, install lockfiles and exact source catalog identity are included. Apply re-plans before staging and immediately before commit.
behavior.extraction: Six portable files per supported ID, including local Composer/queue/textarea presentation, definition, manifest, project glue and notices. Mechanical import transformations retain canonical origin mapping.
behavior.registry: Only an explicit ownership record allows same-ID local source; package registration is excluded, all instances retain IDs and the AppUIModel bytes stay unchanged. Local manifest and service declarations are authoritative, including Creator inspect_ui_plugin.
behavior.baseline: metadataRoot/plugin-ownership.json persists exact package/plugin versions, catalog and approved-plan hashes, origin mapping, shared dependencies and original BASE bytes/hashes independently of node_modules.
behavior.transactions: Validate in a disposable Host with its typecheck/build/test scripts; build is mandatory. Journal commits source, registry, source-lock and ownership together. Failed validation is not committed; crash recovery restores metadata/files and prunes newly created empty takeover directories.
behavior.upgrade: Independent tarball consumer simulates installed package replacement with version 99.0.0 and a deliberately unusable package Composer. Local customization, BASE, IDs/configuration and local registry remain selected through legacy migration and registry regeneration.
behavior.sharedRuntime: Core/Renderer/Runtime and React Context stay shared npm dependencies. Composer support API contract version 1 exposes shared state primitives, contexts, guards and shared attachment/tooltip presentation; package themes/styles/locales remain shared. Optional Lexical facade now externalizes product modules instead of bundling private Context copies.
